memberdef.name: generateImg2Img

briefdescription.para: Img2Img: generate raw RGB pixel data conditioned on an input image.

detaileddescription.para: Default implementation ignores the input image and delegates to generate(). SDCppGenerator will override this with real denoising inference.

parameterdescription.para: Actual width of the generated image.
Actual height of the generated image.

simplesect.para: Raw RGB byte buffer (width * height * 3 bytes).

briefdescription.para: Optionally apply a LoRA adapter for subsequent generation calls.

detaileddescription.para: Default implementation is a no-op that succeeds for generators that do not support LoRA updates.

parameterdescription.para: Path to LoRA adapter (empty means clear LoRA state).

simplesect.para: true on success, false on validation/application failure.

detaileddescription.para: Callers pre-set the next pixel buffer and dimensions. Supports both text-to-image and img2img paths; img2img records whether it was invoked so tests can verify the correct path was taken.
